ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence would best begin a narrative about a farm visit? (1 mark)
   A. I like cows.
   B. Farms grow food.
   C. Last Saturday, my class visited a farm near our school.
   D. The farm is nice.

2. Which question ends with a rising voice? (1 mark)
   A. When did you save the file?
   B. Who saved the file?
   C. How did you save it?
   D. Did you save the file?

3. Which is a polite offer? (1 mark)
   A. Would you like some tea?
   B. You would like a lot tea?
   C. Would you like much tea bags?
   D. Would you like many tea?

4. Target sounds: Which word has the sound /ɔɪ/? (1 mark)
   A. kite
   B. enjoy
   C. car
   D. bird

5. Which sentence uses the right tense with the time word 'yesterday'? (1 mark)
   A. I have saw him yesterday.
   B. I have seen him yesterday.
   C. I saw him yesterday.
   D. I had seen him yesterday now.

6. Which time word usually goes with the present progressive? (1 mark)
   A. at the moment
   B. yesterday
   C. last night
   D. in 2010

7. What should you do first with a series of pictures? (1 mark)
   A. Look at all of them and put them in order
   B. Copy a friend
   C. Write the ending only
   D. Draw only one

8. Which sentence has a lot of a noun we cannot count? (1 mark)
   A. We have a lot of rain in April.
   B. We have a lot of pupils.
   C. We have a lot of cows.
   D. We have a lot of chairs.

9. Which of these is a proper noun? (1 mark)
   A. river
   B. hill
   C. town
   D. Mombasa

10. An antiseptic is (1 mark)
   A. a strip of cloth
   B. a road sign
   C. a liquid or cream that kills germs on a wound
   D. a kind of bicycle

11. Which is a rule for staying safe on the internet? (1 mark)
   A. Share your address
   B. Open messages from strangers
   C. Tell everyone your password
   D. Use it with a parent or teacher

12. Complete: 'That car belongs to my parents. It is ___.' (1 mark)
   A. they
   B. their
   C. theirs
   D. them

13. What does a foot bridge help people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Drive fast
   B. Park cars
   C. Carry luggage
   D. Cross a road safely by walking over it

14. What is an advertisement? (1 mark)
   A. A weather report
   B. A news story
   C. A letter to the editor
   D. A notice that tries to sell something

15. What is a salary? (1 mark)
   A. A school fee
   B. Money borrowed from a bank
   C. Money paid to a worker regularly
   D. Money lost

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write four sentences using words with double consonants that you have learnt. (4 marks)

17. Explain how to make the sound /r/. (3 marks)

18. Describe how to make the sounds /f/ and /v/ and say how they are different. Give one example pair. (4 marks)

19. Name two things that a good listener does when a story is read aloud. (2 marks)

20. Give two examples of regular plurals and two of irregular plurals. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Last Saturday, my class visited a farm near our school.
   It says when, who and where.

2. D — Did you save the file?
   It is a yes or no question.

3. A — Would you like some tea?
   We use some in offers.

4. B — enjoy
   Enjoy has the diphthong /ɔɪ/.

5. C — I saw him yesterday.
   Use the simple past with a finished time such as yesterday.

6. A — at the moment
   'At the moment' shows an action happening now.

7. A — Look at all of them and put them in order
   You must understand the whole story first.

8. A — We have a lot of rain in April.
   Rain cannot be counted.

9. D — Mombasa
   Mombasa is the name of a particular town.

10. C — a liquid or cream that kills germs on a wound
   It cleans wounds by killing germs.

11. D — Use it with a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult keeps you safe.

12. C — theirs
   Theirs shows that the car belongs to them.

13. D — Cross a road safely by walking over it
   It goes over the road.

14. D — A notice that tries to sell something
   Adverts try to sell.

15. C — Money paid to a worker regularly
   A salary is a regular payment for work.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any four correct sentences with correctly spelt double consonant words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pull the tongue back a little and curl the tip up without touching the roof of the mouth, and round the lips slightly. The tongue tip touches nothing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for tongue pulled back, 1 mark for the tip not touching, 1 mark for rounded lips.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Touch the top teeth to the lower lip and blow. /f/ is whispered and /v/ is voiced with a buzz. Example: fan and van.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the mouth position, 1 mark for /f/ whispered, 1 mark for /v/ voiced, 1 mark for the pair.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Look at the speaker; do not interrupt; think about what you hear; ask a question when the speaker finishes (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Regular: books, dishes. Irregular: men, feet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.
